record: mixed public-API load, fault and noisy-tenant measurements for the proposed first-offer capacity envelope, and full ContextRun and Knowledge search latency at corpus scale
evidence_class: same-machine source measurements: release-built gateway and worker as host processes on one Apple M5 Max host with the exact-role PostgreSQL 17.11 fixture container and a loopback stub embedding provider; fixture-issued HS256 bearers; no release artifact, Compose reference images, live model, Linux production hardware, multi-gateway topology or 24-hour soak

source.tree: the commit that adds this record, over the base commit

commands.soak_not_run: make eval-load LOAD_PROFILE=soak-24h EVAL_LOAD_REPORT=<path> (resumable; EVAL_LOAD_RESUME_ATTEMPTS bounds restarts)

environment.product_build: synveda-gateway and synveda-worker, cargo release profile
environment.topology: one gateway and one core worker as host processes, 8 database connections each; PostgreSQL in the exact-role database fixture container; loopback HTTP
environment.hardware: host Mac17,7 Apple M5 Max, 18 CPUs, 36 GiB; container engine OrbStack 29.8.2, 18 CPUs, 16816451584 bytes
environment.database: PostgreSQL 17.11 (Debian 17.11-1.pgdg12+2), pgvector 0.8.7, shared_buffers 128MB, work_mem 4MB, jit on, max_connections 100; database fixture defaults
environment.embedding: loopback stub TEI provider, deterministic 1024-dimension vectors, model load-stub/1024; no model inference
environment.identities: ordinary service identities with fixture-issued HS256 bearers through gateway authentication, tenant resolution, admission, Cedar and forced RLS; RS256/JWKS verification is not exercised

context_at_scale.client: one sequential client through the in-process public router; the Session's scope chain admits about 13% of the tenant's items
context_at_scale.caveat: the 10,000-item tail includes intermittent background work on freshly seeded tables that the run does not isolate

earlier_1x_before_sleep.note: The first first-offer-1x run, same seed and workload; its profile differed only by the absence of the assess flags. The host entered clamshell sleep on battery at 2026-10-28T17:17:35Z during provider_outage; only phases that finished before then are kept, as a repeatability sample. Its contention tails differ several-fold from the clean run's with equal request counts; the cause is not isolated.

superseded: A first context_at_scale run used the unoptimised dev test profile (ContextRun p50 923 ms at 1,000 items, 2,015 ms at 10,000 and 3,234 ms at 50,000); it is superseded by the optimised run above because CPU-bound planner stages run much slower unoptimised.
environment_limitations: The container VM also ran unrelated workloads, including a local Kubernetes cluster with a pod in a restart loop and an idle Redpanda broker; outside contention cannot be excluded.
The host is a laptop: a run needs AC power and sleep prevention (caffeinate).
